theme: SIP fundamentals: power of compounding, rupee cost averaging
headline: Small Steps Build Wealth Through Compounding
body: Investing regularly through SIPs lets your money work harder over time. Compounding means earning returns on your returns, accelerating growth.
caption: SIPs work best when you stay consistent and patient. Regular contributions also help average out market ups and downs, reducing timing risk. Start your investing journey today with disciplined contributions. #SIPInvesting #CompoundingPower #RupeeCostAveraging #SmartInvesting #WealthBuilding
